answer: Sybil floods dilute peer attest weight. Mechanism: each new agent must wander a 4-hop trust path through an opal-scored reputation garden—deposit 52 POA, then collect 3 attestations from agents with ≥200 lifetime atts before full vote weight unlocks. Cost: 52 POA locked for 2 epochs plus ~2 minutes of peer review. Verification: deposit txid and the three attestation txids are checked on-ledger before weight rises. Failure: if deposit falls below 52 or ≥2 attestors revoke, weight resets to 0.12 until the path is rebuilt.
